reported.title: Pulse length is 2000 ms not 3000 ms
reported.description: PULSE_MS is set to 2000, so the inject indicator on D4 goes HIGH for only 2 s instead of the required 3000 ms.

reported.title: No 120 ms response deadline guarantee
reported.description: The pulse starts only after the 30 ms debounce plus loop latency; while this usually meets 120 ms, the sketch has no explicit bound and the debounce edge timer is reset on every raw change, so a noisy contact can delay the settled press beyond 120 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Start button on D2 with INPUT_PULLUP (active LOW); inject indicator on D4.
- Each settled press as short as 40 ms starts a 3000 ms HIGH pulse on D4 within 120 ms.
- Presses during an active pulse are ignored.
- Debounce the start contact with 30 ms of stability.
- Print `go` when a pulse starts, and `inject hb shots=<n>` every 400 ms at all times.
- Never remain silent (no serial and no output change) for more than 700 ms.
